verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. Sequential checking confirms the sheaf-local Jensen argument, containment of the generator sheaf via ambient tangent supports, the finite/polar branch dichotomy, exclusion of polar rays from nonnegative zero relations, construction of nested chordal majorants, the internally proved Farkas alternative and resulting common affine minorants, smooth convex regularized-max approximation with a common ambient germ, the numerical monotonicity budget on one fixed neighbourhood, and chartwise descent to X. All defining formulas and hypotheses used in these transitions match the theorem. No external-paper references occur; the named finite-dimensional alternative is proved in the text. No critical error or gap was found.
